name: Hair Clippers
description: TSA rules for hair clippers on planes.

carryOn.reason: Hair clippers and beard clippers are allowed in carry-on baggage. They are not considered sharp weapons by TSA.

checkedBag.reason: Hair clippers are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring hair clippers on a plane?

travelTips: Hair clippers are fine in carry-on — they are not considered sharp objects by TSA

faq.question: Can I bring hair clippers on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, hair clippers are fully allowed in carry-on and checked baggage. TSA does not classify them as sharp weapons.

faq.question: Are beard clippers allowed in carry-on?
faq.answer: Yes, beard clippers and hair trimmers are permitted in carry-on bags.
